pharmacology.text: (R)-70, or R-70, is a non-hallucinogenic selective serotonin 5-HT2 receptor moderate-efficacy partial agonist of the tetrahydropyridinylpyrrolopyridine family related to the psychedelic tryptamines. It shows preference for activation of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor of about 6.4-fold relative to the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor and of about 30-fold relative to the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied as a possible antidepressant that acts on serotonin 5-HT2 receptors without causing hallucinations in animals.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，被當作可能的抗憂鬱藥來研究，作用於血清素5-HT2受體，而在動物身上不引起幻覺。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，被当作可能的抗忧郁药来研究，作用于血清素5-HT2受体，而在动物身上不引起幻觉。

fact.en: Like the related compound numbered 69, its name is just its number in a research paper. It switches on the 5-HT2A receptor only partly, which may be why animals show no sign of hallucinations.
fact.zh: 和編號69的相關化合物一樣，它的名稱就只是研究論文中的編號。它只部分活化5-HT2A受體，這或許是動物身上看不到幻覺跡象的原因。
fact.zhHans: 和编号69的相关化合物一样，它的名称就只是研究论文中的编号。它只部分活化5-HT2A受体，这或许是动物身上看不到幻觉迹象的原因。
